records.requirement: 1. All 100 questions map to explicitly taught capabilities, not labels ([audit-musk.md:159](audit-musk.md#L159))
records.evidenceAndConclusion: Matrix has seven FAIL capabilities; [L72–76](LESSONS.md#L72)/144–148 are recognition-only for key requirements, [L218](LESSONS.md#L218) only names token bucket, [PLAN228](PLAN.md#L228) only names deprecation. 100 identifiers do not establish semantic teaching.

records.requirement: 2. Learner practices capabilities through materially different examples ([audit-musk.md:160](audit-musk.md#L160))
records.evidenceAndConclusion: [L47](LESSONS.md#L47)/57/82/98/138/150 repeat structures or change surface details; compulsory coverage incomplete. [PROGRESS7](PROGRESS.md#L7) contains no practice outcomes.

records.requirement: 3. Curriculum tests transfer to unfamiliar contexts and representations ([audit-musk.md:161](audit-musk.md#L161))
records.evidenceAndConclusion: [L108](LESSONS.md#L108)/201/223 and [DAA135](DAILY_APPLIED_ASSESSMENTS.md#L135) offer substantive changes; [DAA3](DAILY_APPLIED_ASSESSMENTS.md#L3) makes diagnostic tests optional; full published final is accessible through [index.html:1063](index.html#L1063).

records.requirement: 4. Difficult/advanced work requires synthesis, diagnosis, design or evaluation ([audit-musk.md:162](audit-musk.md#L162))
records.evidenceAndConclusion: [PLAN247–252](PLAN.md#L247) and [ASSESSMENTS.md:115–129](ASSESSMENTS.md#L115) genuinely request integration. No completed evidence or calibrated advanced performance; mathematical/statistical synthesis underrepresented. This condition is present in design but not demonstrated.

records.requirement: 5. Daily completion is based on observable learner-produced evidence ([audit-musk.md:163](audit-musk.md#L163))
records.evidenceAndConclusion: [PLAN9–40](PLAN.md#L9) names artifacts; [L14](LESSONS.md#L14) requires reasoning; [index.html:1153–1174](index.html#L1153) accepts evidence text and self-check, while 779–796 imports empty-evidence PASS. Artifacts themselves absent.

records.requirement: 6. Misconceptions trigger correction/retry, not only answer exposure ([audit-musk.md:164](audit-musk.md#L164))
records.evidenceAndConclusion: [PROGRESS11–22](PROGRESS.md#L11) error template and [DAA45](DAILY_APPLIED_ASSESSMENTS.md#L45)/87/129/171 recovery tasks; optional status, generic [K81](ASSESSMENT_KEYS.md#L81) and surface-only [DAA87](DAILY_APPLIED_ASSESSMENTS.md#L87) prevent reliable repair proof.

records.requirement: 7. Knowledge revisited and integrated across challenge ([audit-musk.md:165](audit-musk.md#L165))
records.evidenceAndConclusion: Reviews at 7/14/21/28 and final [F8](ASSESSMENTS.md#L121)/[F10](ASSESSMENTS.md#L129); [L90](LESSONS.md#L90)/162 selective retrieval leaves uncovered requirements; no delayed results.
Later integrated designs add complexity; no explicit fading or calibrated parallel forms; baseline domain imbalance makes comparisons unreliable.

records.requirement: 9. Final provides credible benchmark/novel-variant evidence without memorized key ([audit-musk.md:167](audit-musk.md#L167))
records.evidenceAndConclusion: Fixed exposed ten-task Form B, near-original [F2](ASSESSMENTS.md#L97), no all-100 subpart acceptance, no sealed novel variants or learner final evidence; [index.html:1046](index.html#L1046) accepts an unfinished attempt for key access.
